{{Money|1,500}} (Group Bonus) |shared_cash = 50% |music-1 = '''Ambience''' [[File:(Official) Tower Defense Simulator OST - It's Getting Frosty|250px]] |music-2 = '''Final Wave ([[Frost Spirit (Frost Invasion)|Frost Spirit]])''' [[File:(Official) Tower Defense Simulator OST - Frost Spirit Theme Song|250px]] |music-ingame-2='''Final Wave ([[Frost Spirit (Frost Invasion)|Frost Spirit]])''' [[File:Tower Defense Simulator OST - Frost Spirit's Theme In-Game|300px]] }} __TOC__ ==Description== '''Outpost 32''' was the event [[Maps|map]] for the [[Frost Invasion Event]]. Like other event maps, it had a specialized wave structure with special [[enemies]]. Upon triumphing, you were awarded with the [[Sledger]], {{Coins|100}}, {{Exp|50}} and {{Shards|200 Shards}}, which could be used in the [[Frost Invasion Event#Frost Invasion Season|Frost Invasion Season]]. You must have been {{Level|25+}} to play this map. In this map, players started off with {{Money|1,400}} ({{Money|1,500}} if players were in the community group). Additionally, the base health was set to 200, regardless of players' levels. Unlike other event maps, you could have up to six people per game. '''Outpost 32''' was a research facility which was researching portals to the frost dimension. A portal malfunctioned, opening the portal to the frost dimension, causing the entire facility to change seasons into winter and allowing enemies from its dimension to spawn in '''Outpost 32'''. ==Design & Path== '''Outpost 32''' was a winter-themed map, with multiple trees, lampposts and snow mounds scattered around the map. It was a fortified research facility. A small pond could be seen in the middle of the map. Near the end of the map, multiple brick walls with lights could be seen, alongside military hangars in the mountains. Several pipes and listening beacons could be seen. The entire research facility was located in a canyon. When the [[Frost Spirit (Frost Invasion)|Frost Spirit]] was defeated, the map became spring-themed, the snow melted and flowers blossomed, symbolizing that the season had been restored. All four stone paths started at a portal before two paths took a turn left and another two took a turn right. They go around the pond and nearby mounds before the four paths connect again when passing by the entrance to the main compound. Later, they divide again going into two separate vehicle tunnels, which were the end of the paths. == Interactive Map == {{Map:Outpost32FrostInvasion}} ==Rewards== The game calculated how much {{Coins|Coins}}, {{Exp|}} and {{Shards|Shards}} you received based on how many waves you survived and if you won a match. During periods of 50% more {{Exp|}} (08:00 UTC Friday – 08:00 UTC Sunday), any {{Exp|}} earned was multiplied by 1.5x. The VIP [[Gamepasses|gamepass]] also multiplied any {{Exp|}} earned by 1.25x. Any rewards that ended in a decimal point was rounded down, no matter the first figure of the leading decimal. Rewards were calculated as: {| class="tds-table pad-10" style="text-align: center; margin:0 auto;" !Currency !Equation |- |{{Coins|Coins}} |{{Coins|50}} × (Waves/20)^1.75 + {{Coins|50}} (Triumph Only) |- |{{Exp|}} |Waves 0-9: {{Exp|1.25}} × Waves
Waves 10-20: {{Exp|2.5}} × Waves |- |{{Shards|Shards}} |{{Shards|200}} × (Waves/20)^1.75 |} ===Badges=== There is also one [[badges|badge]] which you could obtain when playing on this map, which had additional rewards alongside the [[Badges|badge]]. It is: {{Badge |title = Frost Invasion 2021 |description = Send the Frost Spirit back to its realm.. |rewards = [[Sledger]] |image = Winter2020.png |obtainable = No }} ==Wave Structure== In '''Outpost 32''', the formula for calculating wave bonus on each wave is: :({{Money|200}} + ({{Money|300}} × Waves Completed)) ÷ Players The waves in '''Outpost 32''' could be skipped. ==Strategy== *Due to the high number of enemies that spawn in the map, towers that can hit multiple enemies, like the [[Pyromancer]] or [[Mortar]], are highly recommended here. *Like previous event maps, [[Farm]]s do not generate money in this map, so if you need extra money, you can use [[Cowboy]]. **However, during the later waves, you will get a lot of cash due to the large amount of enemies, making the [[Cowboy]] unnecessary. *The [[Pyromancer]] deals double burn damage on this map, making it very useful early on during the game. *Due to the large number of enemies that appear in this event, and the high health enemies, towers that deal high DPS, like the [[Accelerator]], [[Turret]], [[Pursuit]], [[Toxic Gunner]], [[Minigunner]] or [[Ranger]], are strongly recommended. **Be aware of the limited cliff space for the [[Ranger]]. You can place them at certain spots on the central mounds or on cliffs near the end of the path. *The [[Military Base]] only spawns one unit per tower. FireworkTechnicianThumbnail2.png|'''Outpost 32''' on the game thumbnail. {{GalleryHeader|Miscellaneous}} WinterfallView.png|Unused [[Winterfall]] map which '''Outpost 32''' replaced. }} ==Trivia== *Upon defeating the [[Frost Spirit (Frost Invasion)|Frost Spirit]], '''Outpost 32''' changed from a winter theme to a spring theme. This symbolized the fact that the [[Frost Invasion Event]] was released during Spring 2021. *You could gain {{Shards|200 Shards}} even if you lost on the final wave. *'''Outpost 32''' is the first map to have four paths. **It is also the first event map to have more than one path. ***Although the second version of [[Nightmare Carnival]] had two paths, the version used during the [[Halloween 2019 Event]] did not. *The name of the map, '''Outpost 32''', comes from the freezing point of water, which in Fahrenheit is 32°F. *The ambience for '''Outpost 32''' was a remix of [https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=GeKW3UTf-gc cycerin - Winterbliss]. *'''Outpost 32''' went under multiple changes before being added to the game. **This map originally had one path, instead of four. **It was also likely a town instead of a research facility. There was also a river. **Enemies would come out from a cave instead of a portal. *Falling into the pond in the middle of the map would cause you to fall out of the map. **However, using certain emotes, like [[Frozen (Emote)|Frozen]], would let you float in the pond. ==Update History== *'''8 May 2021''' - [[Overhaul v1.3|Overhaul v1.3.0]] **'''Outpost 32''' added. *'''4 December 2021''' - [[v1.0.0]] **'''Outpost 32''' removed. ==Notes== {{MapNavBox}} {{DISPLAYTITLE:Outpost 32}} [[Category:Long Maps]]
